title: Propagation of nonlinear pulses near diffractive points of any order
summary: We construct pulse-type approximate solutions to nonlinear hyperbolic equations near diffractive points, allowing arbitrary (even infinite) order of grazing. We show that in low regularity spaces and the high frequency limit, such solutions can be approximated by a sum of incoming and reflected pulses constructed using incoming and reflected phases and profiles that satisfy transport equations.
